name: The Loan Eligibility Engine - Full Pipeline

parameters.query:
SELECT 
  u.user_id, u.batch_id, u.name, u.email, u.monthly_income, u.credit_score, u.age, u.employment_status,
  p.product_id, p.product_name, p.provider_name, p.interest_rate, p.min_income, p.min_credit_score,
  p.features, p.max_loan_amount
FROM users u
JOIN loan_products p 
  ON  u.credit_score >= p.min_credit_score
  AND u.monthly_income >= p.min_income
  AND u.age BETWEEN p.min_age AND p.max_age
  AND (p.eligible_employment_status IS NULL OR u.employment_status = ANY(p.eligible_employment_status))
WHERE p.is_active = TRUE
LIMIT 100;

INSERT INTO matches (
  user_id, product_id, batch_id, match_score, max_eligible_loan, reasoning, notification_status
) VALUES (
  '{{ $json.user_id }}'::uuid,
  '{{ $json.product_id }}'::uuid,
  '{{ $json.batch_id }}'::uuid,
  {{ $json.match_score }},
  {{ $json.max_eligible_loan }},
  $${{ $json.reasoning }}$$,
  'PENDING'
)
ON CONFLICT (user_id, product_id, batch_id) DO UPDATE SET
  match_score = EXCLUDED.match_score,
  max_eligible_loan = EXCLUDED.max_eligible_loan,
  reasoning = EXCLUDED.reasoning;
SELECT product_id, product_name, provider_name, interest_rate, min_credit_score, min_income, updated_at FROM loan_products ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
  u.user_id, u.name, u.email,
  m.match_id, m.match_score, m.max_eligible_loan, m.reasoning,
  p.product_name, p.provider_name, p.interest_rate, p.features, p.source_url
FROM matches m
JOIN users u ON m.user_id = u.user_id
JOIN loan_products p ON m.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE m.notification_status = 'PENDING'
ORDER BY u.user_id, m.match_score DESC
LIMIT 100;
UPDATE matches SET notification_status = 'SENT' WHERE notification_status = 'PENDING';
